description: GloHydroRes - a global dataset combining open-source hydropower plant and reservoir data is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Jignesh Shah, Jing Hu (Utrecht University). Analyzing the impacts of drought and climate change on hydropower requires detailed data on hydropower attributes such as plant type, head, and installed capacity, and on reservoir characteristics like area, depth, and volume. Current open-source hydropower datasets typically lack information on reservoirs, while reservoir datasets often omit hydropower details. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
